tested_commit_semantics: Base commit plus working-tree changes identified by current artifact SHA-256; not a claim that new tests exist at the base commit.
decision_resolution: Production static accessibility/content audit executes on real explorer source and manifest; CSS and truthful missing-data/claim negatives pass. No browser certification or scientific admission inferred.
positive_checks: Real explorer CSS/main source and canonical manifest pass static audit; null missing observation retained.
negative_checks: Fake zero/0.0/PASS values and source fallbacks, pressure gain/coupled trajectory without admission and missing CSS controls rejected.
limitations: Software verification with synthetic controls only; no physical qualification.
Static JSX/CSS contract checks are not execution of JavaScript or browser accessibility certification.
next_dependency: Independent integrator review; scientific admission still requires qualified source evidence.
